import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree

SAMPLE_FILE = "composites.csv"
BLOCK_FILE = "blocks.csv"
OUTPUT_FILE = "idw_oxide_estimates.csv"
DOMAIN = "OXIDE"
GRADE = "AU_PPM"
RADII_M = np.array([40.0, 30.0, 12.0])
MIN_SAMPLES = 4
MAX_SAMPLES = 16
POWER = 2.0

samples = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_FILE)
blocks = pd.read_csv(BLOCK_FILE)
required_samples = {"X", "Y", "Z", GRADE, "DOMAIN"}
required_blocks = {"BLOCK_ID", "X", "Y", "Z", "DOMAIN"}
if not required_samples.issubset(samples.columns):
    raise ValueError(f"Missing sample columns: {required_samples - set(samples.columns)}")
if not required_blocks.issubset(blocks.columns):
    raise ValueError(f"Missing block columns: {required_blocks - set(blocks.columns)}")

samples = samples.loc[samples["DOMAIN"] == DOMAIN].copy()
samples[GRADE] = pd.to_numeric(samples[GRADE], errors="coerce")
samples = samples.dropna(subset=["X", "Y", "Z", GRADE])
scaled_sample_xyz = samples[["X", "Y", "Z"]].to_numpy(dtype=float) / RADII_M

results = []
for _, block in blocks.iterrows():
    result = block.to_dict()
    result["AU_PPM_EST"] = np.nan
    result["N_COMPOSITES"] = 0
    if block["DOMAIN"] != DOMAIN or samples.empty:
        results.append(result)
        continue

    tree = cKDTree(scaled_sample_xyz)
    center = block[["X", "Y", "Z"]].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    candidate_idx = tree.query_ball_point(center / RADII_M, r=1.0)
    if not candidate_idx:
        results.append(result)
        continue

    candidate_xyz = samples.iloc[candidate_idx][["X", "Y", "Z"]].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    delta = (candidate_xyz - center) / RADII_M
    distance = np.linalg.norm(delta, axis=1)
    order = np.argsort(distance)[:MAX_SAMPLES]
    chosen_idx = np.asarray(candidate_idx)[order]
    chosen_distance = distance[order]
    if len(chosen_idx) < MIN_SAMPLES:
        results.append(result)
        continue

    grades = samples.iloc[chosen_idx][GRADE].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    coincident = chosen_distance <= 1e-12
    if coincident.any():
        estimate = float(grades[coincident].mean())
    else:
        weights = 1.0 / np.power(chosen_distance, POWER)
        estimate = float(np.dot(weights, grades) / weights.sum())
    result["AU_PPM_EST"] = estimate
    result["N_COMPOSITES"] = len(chosen_idx)
    results.append(result)

pd.DataFrame(results).to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False)
estimation_specification: Estimate gold grades for blocks in the OXIDE domain using inverse distance weighting with power 2. Read 1 m composites from composites.csv with columns X, Y, Z, AU_PPM, and DOMAIN, and block centroids from blocks.csv with columns BLOCK_ID, X, Y, Z, and DOMAIN. Use a hard domain boundary, an axis-aligned search ellipsoid with radii 40 m east-west, 30 m north-south, and 12 m vertical, and require 4 to 16 composites. If a block centroid coincides with one or more composites, use the mean grade of those coincident composites. Write estimated grade and informing-composite count to idw_oxide_estimates.csv; blocks without enough composites should receive a missing grade.
